_description: RETIRED AS PROSE — the GAS backend's shape is now DERIVED FROM SOURCE, not restated here.
_why: This file carried a hand-maintained copy of the Google Sheets schema and rotted into
describing a backend that does not exist: a `Businesses` tab (the real one is `Listings`),
plus `Buildings`/`Categories`/`CommunityPosts` that Code.js never opens — while omitting 9
tabs it does open and 7 columns a guardian can edit (menu_json and menu_url among them).
Nothing in the repo read this file. A copy of a source list cannot be kept true; a check can.
_note: The sibling qr-schema.json is untouched by this retirement. Whether `backend/` should exist at all is open — the 2026-08-31 audit flagged it (docs/audits/2026-08-31/REPORT-06-outsider-readiness.md, P9: "named 'backend', contains no backend").
